gov.uk (13:02 BST) + PM statement https://www.gov.uk/government/speeches/prime-ministers-statement-in-the-house-on-historic-forced-adoption-2-july-2026: Starmer Commons ~12:30: 'The shame is not yours. The shame was never yours. The shame is ours.' Also 'a stain on our history'; mothers 'coerced, bullied, or misled'. 185,000 babies 1949-1976 England and Wales. £4m over three years: records access (Coram BAAF), FamilyConnect reunion/intermediary services, testimonial research. No compensation scheme. Phillipson: 'this was wrong, and we are sorry. An apology cannot undo what happened, but it can be the start of real change.' Burghart (Con): 'a stain on our history'. Corroborated: BBC https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c20yq332018o ; ITV lead https://www.itv.com/watch/news/the-latest-headlines-as-starmer-apologies-for-forced-adoption/54g9b5b. Context: March 2026 Education Cttee urged apology; 2023 Conservative govt refused; Wales/Scotland apologised 3 yrs ago; C of E June (Mullally).
